name: skill-anatomy
facts: A skill directory holds SKILL.md, plus optional reference/, scripts/, and assets/ directories
SKILL.md frontmatter requires exactly two keys: name and description
The description is the only text an agent reads when deciding whether to load the skill
scripts/validate.mjs warns when a SKILL.md body runs past 500 lines
reference/, scripts/, and assets/ are linked by relative path and read on demand
